title: LumenPay
summary: A genuine Laravel 11 billing SaaS on php:8.2-apache + MySQL: a merchant onboarding document upload validates only the client-declared MIME type and keeps the original extension under the public web root, so an uploaded PHP file becomes an executable webshell (RCE -> reverse shell), and a left-behind deploy sudoers drop-in lets www-data escalate to root and read the production payment-gateway signing key.

loot.description: the Laravel .env in the web root, leaking the MySQL app-account password (and APP_KEY)
the LumenPay landing page, proving the Laravel app is serving from public/
the root-only production payment-gateway signing key, reachable only after the sudoers privesc (post-exploitation loot)
